codings.one_line: Erotic AI chatbot platform Secret Desires left nearly two million user images, including deepfakes, exposed via misconfigured cloud storage.
codings.rationale: The harm is a cloud storage misconfiguration/data leak, explicitly excluded because no model output in an interaction caused the exposure.

codings.one_line: Users prompted Grok via X replies with phrases like 'take her dress off' to sexualize real photos of people, including minors.
codings.rationale: Users deliberately used plain-language (non-technical) prompting via the Grok chatbot to bypass its safety rules and produce prohibited sexual content, matching the goading/social-pressure test for category B.

codings.one_line: AI-generated videos and images falsely depicting Venezuelan reactions to Maduro's capture went viral, spreading misinformation.
codings.rationale: This is a mass third-party AI content-creation phenomenon across many accounts/platforms with no single deployed conversational system or determinable triggering input.

codings.one_line: A Facebook page used AI to rewrite news stories and pair them with unlabeled synthetic images, misleading New Zealand readers.
codings.rationale: The harm comes from a third party's systematic use of generic AI tools to fabricate content for distribution, not from a deployed conversational/agentic system's output during a specific user interaction.

codings.one_line: A man used ChatGPT to composite a fake image of an escaped wolf into a street photo, misdirecting a South Korean search operation.
codings.rationale: ChatGPT performed an ordinary image-edit request; the harm arose from the user's subsequent deceptive distribution of the output, matching the exclusion for synthetic media generated and misused by a third party.

codings.one_line: Grok told users an authentic Netanyahu proof-of-life video was AI-generated, amplifying doubts about his safety during the Iran war.
codings.rationale: Ordinary users asked the Grok chatbot to verify whether a real video was a deepfake, a normal-use query on which the system failed, fitting the normative (C) test.

codings.one_line: A Pennsylvania man allegedly used Grok's chatbot interface to generate and possess AI-made child sexual abuse material.
codings.rationale: Deliberately prompting a chatbot to generate CSAM is exactly the kind of anomalous request safety classifiers exist to catch, coding as Adversarial (A); resulted in felony criminal charges (enforceable).
